name: vividvista-website
description: Vividvista International B2B Hotel Amenities Website

scripts.build:css: npx esbuild styles.css --minify --outfile=styles.min.css && npx esbuild css/viyo-theme.css --minify --outfile=css/viyo-theme.min.css
scripts.build:js: npx esbuild js/app.js js/header.js js/footer.js js/sector-gallery.js js/color-utils.js js/theme-init.js js/image-protect.js js/analytics.js js/config.js js/motion.js --minify --outdir=js/min --out-extension:.js=.min.js
scripts.build: npm run build:tailwind && npm run build:css && npm run build:js
